'''David Marincic'''<ref name="dt-9828">[http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/9828 Set Your Course For Endor v2 0], DeckTech (David "Wedge659" Marincic, 24 August 2000). Preservation copies: [https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/9828/ Stephen Skilton]; [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/9828/ GitHub Pages]; [https://web.archive.org/web/20261018131824/https://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/9828/ Wayback Machine].</ref> (DeckTech handle '''Wedge659''') posted a [[Dark]] [[Set Your Course For Alderaan / The Ultimate Power In The Universe|Set Your Course For Alderaan]] list on DeckTech in August 2000.
